cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 69% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.66% · WTI -4.70% · Brent -0.06% · NatGas -5.94%. 69% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +4.18%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Refining & Downstream lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +4.18%; weakest is Refining & Downstream at -0.68%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: WFRD is the standout at +8.39%
cards.body: Leaders: WFRD +8.39%, BE +7.96%, VRT +5.23%, TLN +5.15%, CEG +5.00%. Laggards: MPC -1.20%, EQT -1.17%, FANG -0.88%, ENPH -0.84%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
